full_judgment: The opposite party No. 1, Hazarat Ali, filed Misc. Case No. 29 of 1981 under Section 96 of the State Acquisition & Tenancy Act in the Court of Subordinate Judge, 4th Court, Dhaka for pre-emption. His case was that he was a co-sharer by inheritance of the holding and the petitioners, opposite parties Nos. 6 and 14 in the said pre-emption case, sold the land under pre-emption without notice on 4.5.1977 for Tk. 12,000/- to the purchaser opposite party.
